# tomswallapi_address_group (Resource)

An address group, materialized as an nftables named set. Population source is static (CIDRs), dns (FQDNs resolved on-device), or asn (ASNs expanded centrally).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_address_group" "cloudflare" {
  name    = "cloudflare"
  type    = "asn"
  members = ["13335"]
  refresh = "24h"
}

resource "tomswallapi_address_group" "office" {
  name    = "office"
  type    = "static"
  members = ["198.51.100.0/24"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (List of String) For static: CIDRs/IPs. For dns: FQDNs. For asn: ASN numbers.
- `name` (String) Group name (globally unique). ASN groups conventionally use an asn_ prefix.
- `type` (String) Population source: static, dns, or asn.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `refresh` (String) asn: prefix cache TTL (e.g. 24h). dns: honor_ttl.

### Read-Only

- `resolved` (List of String) Server-managed: concrete prefixes the ASN expander last produced.
- `resolved_at` (String) Server-managed: timestamp of the last ASN expansion.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name.
terraform import tomswallapi_address_group.cloudflare cloudflare
```
